items.joke:
A hacker called me. He said he had all my passwords. I said, “Hold on. I’m getting a pen.”
“What are they?”
items.explanation: Speaker forgot passwords and asks the hacker for them, subverting the threat.

idiom.title: Water under the bridge
idiom.interpretationEn: This idiom originates with the imagery of water flowing under a bridge, signifying that the water (or past events) has passed and will not return. In everyday usage, this phrase indicates letting go of past disputes or issues, choosing not to worry about them anymore.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语的起源与河水有关，表示已经流过桥下的水不会再回来，暗喻过去的事情已经发生，无需再为之烦恼或忧虑。在日常生活中，这个短语常用于表示放下过去的争执或矛盾，不再计较。

examples.en: We had our differences in the past, but it’s all water under the bridge now.
examples.zh: 我们过去有些分歧，但现在这些都已经是过眼云烟了。

examples.en: Let’s forget about our old arguments; it’s water under the bridge.
examples.zh: 让我们忘记以前的争吵吧，这都是既往不咎了。

examples.en: They decided to move forward and consider past mistakes as water under the bridge.
examples.zh: 他们决定向前看，把过去的错误看作既往不咎。

people.name: Sandara Park
people.extract: Sandara Park, also known mononymously as Dara (다라), is a South Korean singer, actress and television presenter. She rose to fame in the Philippines as a contestant on the ABS-CBN original talent show Star Circle Quest in 2004, after which she had a successful acting and singing career before returning to South Korea in 2007. She made her Korean debut in 2009 as a member of the K-pop group 2NE1, which became one of the most popular K-pop groups in the world. Park is one of the most recognizable Korean celebrities in the Philippines and is considered a leading figure in the spread of Korean wave into the country.
highlights: South Korean singer, actress, and television presenter.
Rose to fame in Philippines on Star Circle Quest.
Debuted in 2009 as member of K-pop group 2NE1.

people.name: Thorleif Schjelderup-Ebbe
people.extract: Thorleif Schjelderup-Ebbe was a Norwegian zoologist and comparative psychologist. He was the first person to describe a pecking order of hens, a discovery that contributed to understanding dominance hierarchies across species and influenced the field of ethology.
highlights: First to describe pecking order of hens.
Discovery influenced ethology and dominance hierarchies.

people.name: Ivan Šuker
people.extract: Ivan Šuker was a Croatian politician and economist. He served as Minister of Finance from 2003 to 2010, as a member of the Croatian Democratic Union.
highlights: Served as Minister of Finance from 2003 to 2010.
Member of the Croatian Democratic Union.
